testcase.name: Scenario: Change command category while an addition is staged: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:295:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Change command category while an addition is staged ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the ribbon customization dialog has an empty custom panel for "Part | Tools" ✔ And the command category is "All Commands" ✔ When the user adds "2D Sketches" to the custom panel list ✔ And the user selects "Sketch Tab" as the command category ✔ Then the available list displays sketch commands including "Circle (Center Point)" ✔ And "2D Sketches" remains in the custom panel list ✔ And the target selector indicates a pending change ✔ When the user clicks "Cancel" ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And no custom panel appears on the Tools ribbon
